items.summary: All five criteria satisfied: committed-blob evidence, correct phase alignment, non-empty authority-bound TaskReports, consistent closure receipts, zero aliasing.

items.action: gates.py _verify_task_report_evidence_refs now parses the evidence blob and, when it declares ticket_id/evidence_id, requires them to match the TaskReport ticket and declared evidence ref. Negative test test_verifier_rejects_evidence_blob_ticket_mismatch added.
items.summary: Evidence binding is hash-based but not semantic (no operation/ticket cross-check).

items.action: The authority binding (_verify_task_report_authority) requires report.phase == ticket.phase exactly; the envelope manifest requires a phase field. There is no phase-agnostic operation path in the coordinator; B-03's premise does not exist.
items.summary: TaskReport phase not sourced from ticket, causing false rejections of phase-agnostic operations.

items.action: The evidence files were committed BEFORE their gates built/closed (each evidence commit precedes its gate commit).
